entries.title: Site Monitor extension card.
entries.notes: Committed Marketplace card preview for Site Monitor.
entries.useCase: An operator reviews the extension card before enabling site monitoring.

entries.title: Site Monitor dashboard.
entries.notes: Committed data-backed dashboard proof with seeded target state, open incidents, and latest check evidence.
entries.useCase: An operator reviews target state, open incidents, and latest check evidence.

entries.title: Site Monitor incident detail.
entries.notes: Committed data-backed incident proof with failure evidence and resolution state.
entries.useCase: An operator inspects failure evidence and resolution state.

entries.title: Site Monitor target form.
entries.notes: Capture the target setup form once the admin runner can expose the resource, including URL, check type, interval, notification policy, and enabled state.
entries.useCase: An operator configures what Capell should monitor for a site.

entries.title: Site Monitor check history.
entries.notes: Capture check history with uptime, SSL, domain-expiry, and failed-response evidence when a route-backed admin resource is available.
entries.useCase: An operator compares recent checks before deciding whether an incident is resolved.

entries.title: Site Monitor targets index.
entries.notes: Capture enabled, disabled, passing, warning, and failing targets with latest run and open incident indicators visible.
entries.useCase: An operator scans every monitored target and identifies which ones need attention.

entries.title: Site Monitor run check action result.
entries.notes: Run the target table action against a seeded target and capture the notification/result state after a passing or failing check is recorded.
entries.useCase: An operator manually verifies a target after deploying a fix.

entries.title: Site Monitor incident resolution form.
entries.notes: Capture an open incident edit screen with target, latest failing run, status, and resolution fields visible.
entries.useCase: An operator documents why an outage is resolved and keeps the incident audit trail clear.

entries.title: Site Monitor doctor output.
entries.notes: Capture command or rendered proof output showing storage, command registration, freshness, and open incident health checks.
entries.useCase: An operator verifies Site Monitor is installed and scheduled checks are healthy.

entries.title: Site Monitor incident notification.
entries.notes: Capture a rendered alert notification for opened and resolved incidents with target URL, failing evidence, and timestamps, using safe fixture domains.
entries.useCase: An operator receives actionable outage context without opening the admin panel first.
